errors.description: The key gcd-preservation claim in Step 3 is stated but its (one-line, Euclidean-algorithm) verification is skipped; also the passage from pairwise common divisors to invariance of the full N-tuple gcd is asserted rather than spelled out. Both are immediate, so this is at most a cosmetic omission.
errors.quote: (standard; details omitted). In all cases $G_p$ is invariant.

parsed.notes: Termination via product/number-of-ones potential is correct and correctly bounded; 'no move creates two 1's' gives existence of a surviving entry >1; prime-wise gcd-of-valuations invariant correctly yields the choice-independent M. Computer checks are decorative, not load-bearing.
